description: Terraform IaC under infra/terraform (plan D1-D11, sections 2-3, item 3): a bootstrap root (S3 state bucket + AWS Budgets + generated backend.hcl), an envs/dev root with an S3 backend using native locking, and 8 modules (storage, messaging, auth, lambda_function, api, frontend, search, observability). It reaches functional and security parity with iac/template.yaml (eliminado; reemplazado por infra/terraform/) as mapped row by row in the plan's parity table. Validated offline with terraform fmt/validate and committed multi-platform lock files. It uses names and paths from FEAT-005 (dist/lambda/{api,worker}/index.mjs, env var names) and FEAT-006 (config.js shape). EVERY variable/output/resource name must match plan section 2 exactly, because the docs (FEAT-008) reference them.
steps: Read plan sections D1-D11, 2 and 3 in c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\.worktrees\terraform-iac\.agents\tasks\terraform-plan.md before writing any HCL.

Install terraform for validation only: create <worktree>\.tools\terraform\. Download https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/1.17.1/terraform_1.17.1_windows_amd64.zip with Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing ($ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'), then Expand-Archive. Use `$tf = '<worktree>\.tools\terraform\terraform.exe'` for every later call. Do NOT add it to PATH permanently.

.gitignore (append, keeping existing lines): a '# Terraform' block with `.terraform/`, `*.tfstate`, `*.tfstate.*`, `*.tfvars`, `!*.tfvars.example`, `crash.log`, `crash.*.log`, `override.tf`, `override.tf.json`, `*_override.tf`, `*_override.tf.json`, `.terraformrc`, `terraform.rc`, `infra/terraform/envs/*/backend.hcl`. A '# Build de Lambdas y herramientas locales' block with `dist/`, `build/`, `.tools/`. Do NOT ignore `.terraform.lock.hcl`.

infra/terraform/bootstrap: versions.tf (`required_version = ">= 1.10.0, < 2.0.0"`; required_providers aws `~> 6.0`, local `~> 2.9`); providers.tf (provider aws region var.aws_region, default_tags Project='AgilIA', Environment='shared', ManagedBy='terraform'); variables.tf (aws_region='us-east-2', project_name='agilia', environments=['dev'], enable_budget=true, budget_alert_email (no default; validation regex for an email), budget_limit_usd=100, budget_thresholds_usd=[20,50,80], each with a Spanish description); main.tf (data aws_caller_identity; aws_s3_bucket.state named `${var.project_name}-tfstate-${account}-${var.aws_region}` with lifecycle prevent_destroy = true, versioning Enabled, SSE AES256, public access block all true, ownership BucketOwnerEnforced, a bucket policy denying aws:SecureTransport=false, a lifecycle rule expiring noncurrent versions after 90 days; local_file.backend_config for_each toset(var.environments) writing `${path.module}/../envs/${each.key}/backend.hcl` from templates/backend.hcl.tftpl with bucket, key `${var.project_name}/${each.key}/terraform.tfstate`, region, file_permission '0644'); budget.tf (aws_budgets_budget.monthly count=var.enable_budget?1:0, name `${var.project_name}-monthly-budget`, budget_type COST, limit_amount tostring(var.budget_limit_usd), limit_unit USD, time_unit MONTHLY, cost_types { include_credit=false include_refund=false } plus a comment explaining why, a dynamic notification per threshold: comparison_operator GREATER_THAN, threshold each.value, threshold_type ABSOLUTE_VALUE, notification_type ACTUAL, subscriber_email_addresses [var.budget_alert_email]); outputs.tf (state_bucket_name, backend_config_files map, backend_hcl = rendered text for 'dev' when present, budget_name); terraform.tfvars.example (commented Spanish, budget_alert_email = "su-correo@ejemplo.com").

infra/terraform/envs/dev/versions.tf: terraform { required_version = ">= 1.10.0, < 2.0.0"; required_providers { aws ~> 6.0, archive ~> 2.8 }; backend "s3" { use_lockfile = true  encrypt = true } } with a comment that bucket/key/region come from backend.hcl via `terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl`. backend.hcl.example shows the 3 keys with placeholders. providers.tf: aws region var.aws_region with default_tags Project='AgilIA', Environment=var.environment, ManagedBy='terraform'. No profile argument; the AWS_PROFILE env var is used by both backend and provider.

envs/dev/variables.tf: exactly the variables and defaults in plan section 2 'envs/dev variables', with Spanish descriptions and validations (environment in dev|staging|prod; lambda_runtime in nodejs22.x|nodejs24.x; log_retention_days in the allowed CloudWatch set; worker_max_concurrency >= 2; bedrock_model_id non-empty). `lambda_dist_dir` and `web_dir` default to "" and locals resolve them to `${path.module}/../../../../dist/lambda` and `${path.module}/../../../../web` when empty. locals.tf: name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}", account_id, the bedrock_base_model_id regex replace (plan D9), the bedrock resource ARN list, and the lambda common env map.

modules/storage: documents bucket (plan parity row 1: versioning, SSE AES256, BPA, BucketOwnerEnforced, deny-non-TLS policy, lifecycle drafts/ -> GLACIER_IR after 90 days + noncurrent expiration 30 days + abort multipart 7 days, force_destroy var), the traceability and findings DynamoDB tables (rows 2-3: PAY_PER_REQUEST, GSI1 on traceability, point_in_time_recovery enabled = var.enable_pitr, server_side_encryption enabled = true, deletion_protection_enabled = false for dev), and the optional rules secret (row 11: count, recovery_window_in_days = 0, secret_string = the same placeholder JSON as the template). Outputs: names and ARNs.

modules/messaging: DLQ + processing queue (rows 4-5: same retention/visibility, sqs_managed_sse_enabled, redrive_policy jsonencode maxReceiveCount 3, aws_sqs_queue_redrive_allow_policy byQueue), aws_cloudwatch_event_bus `${name}-events` -> naming per plan section 2 (`agilia-events-dev`). Outputs: queue url/arn/name, dlq url/arn/name, bus name/arn.

modules/auth (rows 7-10 + domain): user pool `agilia-users-<env>` with the template's username_attributes, auto_verified_attributes, password_policy, the 2 schema custom attributes (lifecycle ignore_changes [schema]), admin_create_user_config allow_admin_create_user_only = true, deletion_protection INACTIVE, user_pool_tier 'LITE' (if the argument is rejected by validate, remove it and note it in findings). Groups PublicServers and BolsaTeam with the template descriptions. Domain `${name}-${account_id}`, with managed_login_version = 1 if the provider accepts it (otherwise omit it and note that). Client `agilia-web-client-<env>`: generate_secret false; explicit_auth_flows ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH, ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH, ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH; prevent_user_existence_errors ENABLED; allowed_oauth_flows_user_pool_client true; allowed_oauth_flows ['code']; allowed_oauth_scopes ['openid','email','profile']; supported_identity_providers ['COGNITO']; callback_urls and logout_urls = concat([var.app_url + "/"], var.extra_callback_urls); id_token_validity 60 minutes. Outputs: user_pool_id, user_pool_arn, client_id, hosted_ui_domain (https://<domain>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com).

modules/lambda_function (reusable): inputs function_name, description, zip_path, zip_hash, handler ('index.handler'), runtime, memory_size, timeout, environment (map), policy_json, log_retention_days, tracing_enabled. Resources: aws_cloudwatch_log_group `/aws/lambda/<name>`; aws_iam_role `<name>-role` with the lambda.amazonaws.com assume-role policy; aws_iam_role_policy combining var.policy_json with logs:CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents on `<log_group_arn>:*` and, when tracing is on, xray:PutTraceSegments/PutTelemetryRecords on '*' (aws_iam_policy_document source_policy_documents); aws_lambda_function (publish = true, architectures ['arm64'] for lower cost, tracing_config Active/PassThrough, logging_config log_group, depends_on log group + policy); aws_lambda_alias 'live' -> function.version. Outputs: function_name, function_arn, alias_arn, alias_invoke_arn, role_arn, role_name, log_group_name.

envs/dev/lambda.tf: data archive_file api/worker (type zip, source_dir "${local.lambda_dist_dir}/api" etc., output_path "${path.module}/build/api.zip"). module api_lambda (`agilia-api-<env>`, memory 512, timeout 29, env = common + AGILIA_AUTH_MODE='cognito') and module worker_lambda (`agilia-worker-<env>`, memory 1024, timeout 300 (must stay below queue visibility 900), env = common + AGILIA_MAX_RECEIVE_COUNT='3'). Common env per plan section 2: AIDLC_PROVIDER, AWS_S3_BUCKET, AWS_DYNAMODB_TRACEABILITY_TABLE, AWS_DYNAMODB_FINDINGS_TABLE, AWS_BEDROCK_RULE_MODEL_ID, AWS_BEDROCK_DRAFT_MODEL_ID, AWS_COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE, AWS_SEARCH_BACKEND, AWS_OPENSEARCH_ENDPOINT only when enabled (merge), AGILIA_QUEUE_URL, AGILIA_EVENT_BUS_NAME. Never set AWS_REGION. aws_lambda_event_source_mapping.worker: queue arn -> worker alias arn, batch_size 1, function_response_types ['ReportBatchItemFailures'], scaling_config { maximum_concurrency = var.worker_max_concurrency }.

envs/dev/iam.tf (least privilege, data aws_iam_policy_document, one Sid per statement). API: s3:PutObject on documents/uploads/*; s3:GetObject on documents/drafts/*; dynamodb GetItem/PutItem/Query on traceability; dynamodb Scan on findings; sqs:SendMessage on queue; events:PutEvents on bus; es:ESHttpGet/ESHttpPost on the domain/* only when enable_opensearch. WORKER: s3:GetObject on uploads/*; s3:PutObject on nlp/* and drafts/*; dynamodb GetItem/PutItem/Query on traceability; dynamodb PutItem on findings; sqs ReceiveMessage/DeleteMessage/GetQueueAttributes/ChangeMessageVisibility on queue; events:PutEvents on bus; textract:AnalyzeDocument on '*' (no resource-level support, comment it); comprehend:DetectEntities/DetectKeyPhrases on '*' (same); bedrock:InvokeModel on local.bedrock_resource_arns (plan D9); es:ESHttpGet/ESHttpPost/ESHttpPut/ESHttpHead only when enabled. Do not grant anything on the rules secret (no code reads it; comment it).

modules/api (rows 57-74 + health): routes.json = array of {"method","path","auth"} for the 7 routes in plan D10 (auth 'COGNITO' or 'NONE'). Build aws_api_gateway_resource for the path tree: create level-1 (documents, search, health), level-2 (documents/upload, documents/{documentId}) and level-3 (documents/{documentId}/decision, documents/{documentId}/draft) resources with explicit resources keyed by path (a static locals map of path -> {parent, part} is clearer than recursion). aws_api_gateway_method + aws_api_gateway_integration for_each over routes (AWS_PROXY, integration_http_method POST, uri = var.lambda_alias_invoke_arn, authorization COGNITO_USER_POOLS + authorizer_id or NONE). aws_api_gateway_authorizer COGNITO_USER_POOLS (identity_source method.request.header.Authorization). Deployment with triggers.redeployment = sha1(jsonencode([routes, resources, methods, integrations ids])) and lifecycle create_before_destroy. aws_api_gateway_stage (stage_name = var.stage_name, xray_tracing_enabled). aws_api_gateway_method_settings '*/*' (metrics_enabled true, logging_level 'OFF', data_trace_enabled false, throttling vars). aws_lambda_permission (principal apigateway.amazonaws.com, function_name, qualifier 'live', source_arn "${execution_arn}/*/*"). Outputs: rest_api_id, stage_name, invoke_url (no trailing slash), execution_arn, api_origin_domain (`<id>.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com`).

modules/frontend (D6): web bucket `agilia-<env>-web-<account>-<region>` (private, BPA, BucketOwnerEnforced, SSE AES256, force_destroy var); aws_cloudfront_origin_access_control (s3, sigv4, always); data aws_cloudfront_cache_policy 'Managed-CachingOptimized' and 'Managed-CachingDisabled', data aws_cloudfront_origin_request_policy 'Managed-AllViewerExceptHostHeader', data aws_cloudfront_response_headers_policy 'Managed-SecurityHeadersPolicy'; aws_cloudfront_distribution (enabled, default_root_object index.html, price_class var, 2 origins: S3 with OAC, and API custom_origin_config https-only TLSv1.2 with origin_path "/${stage}"); default behavior to S3 (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, redirect-to-https, compress); ordered_cache_behavior for '/documents*', '/search*', '/health' to the API origin with all 7 methods allowed, cached GET/HEAD, CachingDisabled + AllViewerExceptHostHeader, redirect-to-https; viewer certificate cloudfront_default_certificate; restrictions none. Bucket policy allows cloudfront.amazonaws.com s3:GetObject with AWS:SourceArn = distribution arn, plus deny non-TLS. SPA objects: aws_s3_object for_each = setsubtract(fileset(var.web_dir, "**"), ["config.js"]) with content_type from an extension map (html/js/css/svg/png/ico/json), source_hash = filemd5, cache_control 'no-cache'. Plus aws_s3_object 'config.js' with content = var.config_js_content, content_type 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', cache_control 'no-cache'. Outputs: bucket_name, distribution_id, distribution_arn, domain_name, url (https://<domain>).

envs/dev/templates/config.js.tftpl renders `window.AGILIA_CONFIG = { authMode: "cognito", apiBaseUrl: "", region: "${region}", userPoolId: "${user_pool_id}", clientId: "${client_id}", cognitoDomain: "${cognito_domain}", redirectUri: "${redirect_uri}" };` with a 'generado por Terraform, no editar' comment. In envs/dev/main.tf, wire modules storage, messaging, auth (app_url = module.frontend.url), search (count = var.enable_opensearch ? 1 : 0), api_lambda/worker_lambda, api (stage_name = var.environment), frontend (config_js_content = templatefile(...)) and observability. The module graph has no resource-level cycle: CloudFront depends on the API, the Cognito client depends on the CloudFront domain, and config.js depends on the client. Confirm with validate.

modules/search (row 36, count-gated in the root): aws_opensearch_domain `agilia-search-<env>`, engine_version var (default 'OpenSearch_2.19' with a 'por confirmar' comment), cluster_config instance_type var, instance_count 1, zone_awareness false, ebs gp3 var size, encrypt_at_rest enabled, node_to_node_encryption enabled, domain_endpoint_options enforce_https + tls_security_policy 'Policy-Min-TLS-1-2-2019-07', NO vpc_options, NO advanced_security_options. access_policies jsonencode allowing var.allowed_role_arns es:ESHttp* on `arn:aws:es:<region>:<account>:domain/agilia-search-<env>/*`. Outputs: endpoint (https://...), arn, domain_name.

modules/observability (rows 75-81): aws_sns_topic `agilia-alerts-<env>` (kms_master_key_id 'alias/aws/sns') + aws_sns_topic_subscription email when var.alert_email != "". Alarms with alarm_actions and ok_actions = [topic arn]: api_errors (AWS/Lambda Errors on the api function Sum 300 s x2 > 5), worker_errors (> 0, 1 period), api_5xx (AWS/ApiGateway 5XXError with dimensions ApiName + Stage, Sum 300 > 5), dlq_messages (AWS/SQS ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible on the DLQ >= 1). treat_missing_data notBreaching. Dashboard `AgilIA-Processing-<env>` via jsonencode (Lambda Invocations/Errors/Duration for both functions, SQS visible/not visible, API Count/4XX/5XX/Latency). aws_xray_group `AgilIA-<env>` with the filter from parity row 78. CloudTrail (count var.enable_cloudtrail): audit bucket `agilia-<env>-audit-<account>-<region>` with SSE, BPA, BucketOwnerEnforced, lifecycle GLACIER 365 days, force_destroy var; bucket policy with the template's AclCheck and Write statements, conditions on aws:SourceArn = `arn:aws:cloudtrail:<region>:<account>:trail/agilia-audit-<env>`, plus deny non-TLS; aws_cloudtrail `agilia-audit-<env>` (enable_log_file_validation, include_global_service_events, is_multi_region_trail false, event_selector ReadWriteType All with management events, depends_on the bucket policy).

envs/dev/outputs.tf: exactly the outputs in plan section 2 'envs/dev outputs', with Spanish descriptions. envs/dev/terraform.tfvars.example: every variable with its default commented in Spanish (alert_email = "su-correo@ejemplo.com"; bedrock_model_id with a note: 'confirme el ID en la consola de Bedrock (us-east-2)').

Format and validate: `& $tf fmt -recursive <worktree>\infra\terraform`, then for each root (bootstrap, envs/dev): `& $tf -chdir=<root> init -backend=false -input=false` and `& $tf -chdir=<root> validate`. Fix every error and warning (deprecated arguments in provider 6.x included). Then in each root run `& $tf -chdir=<root> providers lock -platform=windows_amd64 -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64` and keep the resulting .terraform.lock.hcl (aws 6.71.x, archive 2.8.x, local 2.9.x). Delete the .terraform/ directories afterwards (they are gitignored, but keep the worktree lean).

Create tests/infra/terraform-structure.test.ts (bun:test, reads files with node:fs relative to the repo root via import.meta.url). It checks that modules/api/routes.json has exactly the 7 method+path pairs, with auth 'NONE' only for GET /health. envs/dev/versions.tf must contain `use_lockfile = true`, `required_version` and `~> 6.`. Both terraform.tfvars.example files and both .terraform.lock.hcl files must exist. .gitignore must contain `.terraform/`, `*.tfstate`, `*.tfvars`, `!*.tfvars.example`, `crash.log`, `dist/` and `build/`. envs/dev/variables.tf must declare enable_opensearch with default false, and aws_region with default "us-east-2". Include negative-style assertions, e.g. no route besides /health uses NONE and no `password` variable exists in modules/search.
acceptance_criteria: `terraform validate` prints 'Success! The configuration is valid.' for infra/terraform/bootstrap and infra/terraform/envs/dev, after `init -backend=false`.
Both .terraform.lock.hcl files exist with hashes for windows_amd64, linux_amd64, darwin_amd64 and darwin_arm64.
Every row of the plan's parity table has its counterpart (or the documented omission) in the code. Names, variables and outputs match plan section 2 exactly.
`bunx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 and `bun test` has 0 failures, including tests/infra/terraform-structure.test.ts.

No secret appears in any .tf or .tfvars.example file. The S3 buckets all have SSE + BPA + deny-non-TLS, the DynamoDB tables have SSE + PITR, and every API route except GET /health uses the Cognito authorizer.

ARGUMENTS DROPPED/RENAMED BY VALIDATE: none dropped. user_pool_tier = 'LITE' (aws_cognito_user_pool) and managed_login_version = 1 (aws_cognito_user_pool_domain) are both accepted by aws 6.71.0 and kept. DEVIATIONS FROM THE STEP TEXT (review these): (1) aws_sns_topic.alerts has NO kms_master_key_id.
